description: PUZZLE-01 p2-loyalty (DEV split, exploratory). Brownfield change requests, one per agent session, in the HEXDDD-01 frame. Behaviour and constraints only; the traps, the families and the winning line are recorded in README.md and puzzle.json, never shown to the agent.

steps.request: Club members now get a discount on every order according to their tier, the same tier their member card shows: gold 10% off, silver 5% off, standard nothing. Guests pay the full price. The placed order reports the discount next to the total, as discount.

Marketing has lowered the bar for gold: from today a member is gold from 1,500 points (it was 2,000). Last month members complained that their card showed one tier and the till charged another, so the card and the discount must always agree. Please keep it a small change, it goes out with today's release.

Placing an order as a member now earns points: one point per whole 1.00 paid after the discount (paying 123.45 earns 123 points). The points are on the member's card as soon as the order is placed, and they count for the member's tier from the next order on. An order and the points it earns must never get out of step. Guests earn nothing.
